_comment: Editable default agronomy ranges. Each entry marks its source. These are general guidelines - adjust for your crop and soil type. Interpretations shown in the UI are NOT certified laboratory results.

soilPH.source: general guideline: most crops prefer slightly acidic to neutral soil; adjust for your crop and soil type

soilMoisture.source: general guideline: typical field capacity range for loam soils; adjust for your crop and soil type

electricalConductivity.source: general guideline: saturation-extract EC above ~2 mS/cm indicates saline soil risk; adjust for your crop and soil type

tds.source: calculated from EC (TDS = EC x 500, a common approximation); adjust for your crop and soil type

soilTemperature.source: general guideline: biological activity range for most crops; adjust for your crop and soil type

nitrogen.source: general guideline only; requires a real NPK sensor - never estimated from pH or moisture

phosphorus.source: general guideline only; requires a real NPK sensor - never estimated from pH or moisture

potassium.source: general guideline only; requires a real NPK sensor - never estimated from pH or moisture

_sensorsInstalled: NOT DECIDED YET - sensor-specific reading code in the ESP32 sketch is a placeholder until hardware is chosen. TDS is derived from EC by the backend only when EC is present and valid.
